subject.title: feat(opencode): hybrid models.dev + gateway catalog freshness

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared, private-local hybrid provider-catalog runtime that consumes models.dev metadata for bundled OpenCode Zen and Go plugins, rather than limiting catalog maintenance to plugin-owned static synchronization?
rationale: The decision sets a reusable provider-data and network-refresh policy across bundled plugins, including how external metadata may influence user-visible model availability and accounting fields.

options.title: Sponsor bounded hybrid catalogs
options.body: Accept the shared internal helper after it refreshes metadata for newly discovered gateway IDs, preserves static offline behavior, and has live after-fix proof.

options.title: Keep catalog data plugin-local
options.body: Limit the work to plugin-owned static catalog synchronization and avoid a new shared models.dev runtime dependency.

options.title: Pause for provider policy
options.body: Defer both approaches until maintainers define the supported source-of-truth and refresh policy for dynamic provider metadata.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded hybrid catalogs
recommendation.body: Accept the shared internal helper after it refreshes metadata for newly discovered gateway IDs, preserves static offline behavior, and has live after-fix proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the concrete tracker and implementation proposal; a current-main area owner should be added after maintainer history review.
